DEFINE CLASS tg_abrirform AS commandbutton 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="commandbutton" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*p: cformaabrir
		*p: ctipo
		*p: ofrm
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		BackColor = 0,111,163
		Caption = "Prueba"
		cformaabrir = .F.
		ctipo = .F.
		ForeColor = 255,255,255
		Height = 49
		MousePointer = 15
		Name = "tg_abrirform"
		ofrm = .F.
		Picture = ..\bmp\eiffel_ico.ico
		PicturePosition = 13
		SpecialEffect = 1
		Style = 0
		Width = 120
	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE Click
		DO CASE
			CASE this.cTipo="ABM"
				oApp.DoForm("Tg_FormAbm",ALLTRIM(this.cFormAAbrir),.t.)                                  
			CASE this.cTipo="LIS"
				oApp.DoForm("Tg_Listados",UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.cFormAAbrir)))
			CASE this.cTipo="PRO"
				oApp.DoForm(ALLTRIM(this.cFormAAbrir))
			CASE this.cTipo="CON"
				oApp.DoForm(ALLTRIM(this.cFormAAbrir))
			CASE this.cTipo="EJE"
				oApp.Ejecutar(ALLTRIM(this.cFormAAbrir))
			CASE this.cTipo="OTR"
				lbTemp = ALLTRIM(this.cFormAAbrir)
				&lbTemp.
		ENDCASE
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LPARAMETERS cForm, cTipo
		
		this.cFormAAbrir = cForm
		this.cTipo = cTipo
		this.WordWrap = .T.
		
		IF thisform.oTblProcesos.buscar(this.cTipo, .F., "CLAVE")
			this.BackColor = thisform.oTblProcesos.leer("colorFondo")
			this.ForeColor = thisform.oTblProcesos.leer("colorLetra")
		ELSE
			this.BackColor = RGB(229,20,0)
			this.ForeColor = RGB(255,255,255)
		ENDIF 
		
		
		*!*	DO CASE
		*!*		CASE this.cTipo="ABM"
		*!*			this.BackColor = RGB(164,196,0)
		*!*		CASE this.cTipo="LIS"
		*!*			this.BackColor = RGB(170,0,255)
		*!*		CASE this.cTipo="PRO"
		*!*			this.BackColor = RGB(216,0,115)
		*!*		CASE this.cTipo="CON"
		*!*			this.BackColor = RGB(227,200,0)
		*!*		CASE this.cTipo="EJE"
		*!*			this.BackColor = RGB(130,90,44)
		*!*		CASE this.cTipo="OTR"
		*!*			this.BackColor = RGB(135,121,78)
		*!*	ENDCASE
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE MouseEnter
		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord
		
		this.BackColor = this.BackColor - 40
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE MouseLeave
		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord
		
		this.BackColor = this.BackColor + 40
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_busqueda AS container 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="container" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*-- OBJECTDATA items order determines ZOrder / El orden de los items OBJECTDATA determina el ZOrder 
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_commandbutton1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />

	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*m: cargarbotones
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		BackColor = 255,255,255
		BackStyle = 0
		BorderWidth = 0
		Height = 387
		Name = "tg_busqueda"
		Width = 650
	*</PropValue>

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_commandbutton1' AS tg_commandbutton WITH ;
		BackColor = 255,255,255, ;
		Caption = "", ;
		Height = 36, ;
		Left = 12, ;
		Name = "Tg_commandbutton1", ;
		Picture = ..\bmp\menu_volver.png, ;
		PicturePosition = 13, ;
		SpecialEffect = 1, ;
		Top = 12, ;
		Width = 44
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="commandbutton" />
	
	PROCEDURE cargarbotones
		lParameters cLetrasBusqueda
		
		LOCAL nTop, nAltoTotal, nTopInicial, nLeft, nAncho, nAlto, nCantidadBtn, nAnchoChico, nAltoChico, nLeftInicial 
		LOCAL nCantBotonesDelMenu, nMaximoLenCaption, nCantIdealAncho, nCantIdealLargo, lIdealEncontrado, nAnchos, nCantIdealLargoEx, nAltoExacto
		nAltoTotal = this.Height
		nTopInicial= 30
		nTop = nTopInicial
		nLeftInicial = 2
		nLeft = nLeftInicial
		nAncho = 200
		nAnchoChico = 100
		nAlto = 75
		nAltoChico = 50
		nCantidadBtn = 1
		
		nCantBotonesDelMenu = 0
		nMaximoLenCaption = 0
		nCantIdealAncho = 0
		nCantIdealLargo = 0
		nCantIdealLargoEx = 0
		lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		nAnchos = 0
		nCantBotonesDelMenu = 0
		nMaximoLenCaption = 0
		
		this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.Refrescar()
		this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.filtrar("LIKE('*" + UPPER(ALLTRIM(cLetrasBusqueda)) + "*', UPPER(etiqueta))")
		this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.EsEof()
			IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.Leer("id_tipoproceso"))) <> "SUB"
				nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
				
				IF nMaximoLenCaption < LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.Leer("Etiqueta")))
					nMaximoLenCaption = LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.Leer("Etiqueta")))
				ENDIF 
			ENDIF 
			this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		nCantIdealAncho = 1
		nCantIdealLargo = 1
		nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargo 
		lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		DO WHILE !lIdealEncontrado
			IF nCantBotonesDelMenu / nCantIdealAncho <= nCantIdealLargo
				lIdealEncontrado = .T.
			ELSE
				nCantIdealAncho = nCantIdealAncho + 1
				nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargoEx + 3/4
				nCantIdealLargo = ROUND(nCantIdealLargoEx,0)
			ENDIF 
		ENDDO 		
		
		nAncho = 100 
		nAltoExacto = 75
		nAlto = nAltoExacto
		nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 2 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
		nLeft = nLeftInicial
		
		nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - (nAlto + 2 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho,0)) / 2,0)
		nTop = nTopInicial 
		DO WHILE nLeftInicial < 2 OR nTopInicial < 2
			nAncho = nAncho - 1
			nAltoExacto = nAltoExacto - 3/4
			nAlto = ROUND(nAltoExacto,0)
		
			nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 2 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
			nLeft = nLeftInicial
			
			nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - (nAlto + 2 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho,0)) / 2,0)
			nTop = nTopInicial 
		ENDDO 
		
		this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.irPrimero()
		DO WHILE !this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.EsEof()
		 	IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.Leer("id_tipoproceso"))) <> "SUB"
		 		
		 		thisform.nIdBotonBusqueda = thisform.nIdBotonBusqueda + 1
		
				this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBotonBusqueda)),"tg_abrirForm", this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.Leer("id_proceso"), this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.Leer("id_tipoproceso"))
				
				lbObject = "this.oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBotonBusqueda))
				WITH &lbObject.
				
		*!*					lbIco = this.oVwOpciones.Leer("imagen")
		*!*					IF !EMPTY(lbIco)
		*!*						.picture = "c:\targetdesarrollo\bmp\"+ALLTRIM(lbico)
		*!*					ENDIF				
					.Caption = ALLTRIM(this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.Leer("Etiqueta"))
					.Width = nAncho
					.Height = nAlto
					.Visible = .T.
					
					.Top = nTop
					.Left= nLeft
					
					nAnchos = nAnchos + 1
					IF nAnchos < nCantIdealAncho
						nLeft = nLeft + .Width + 2
					ELSE
						nLeft = nLeftInicial
						nAnchos = 0
						nTop = nTop + .height + 2
					ENDIF 
				ENDWITH
			ENDIF 
			this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
			
			
			
			
			
			
			
			
			
			
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		this.AddObject("oViewMenuTreeViewAll", "tg_viewMenuTreeViewAll")
		
		FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].parentClass) = UPPER("Container")
				thisform.Objects[i].visible = .F.
			ENDIF  
		ENDFOR 
		
		this.Visible = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].parentClass) = UPPER("Container")
				thisform.Objects[i].visible = .T.
			ENDIF  
		ENDFOR 
		
		thisform.oTbxBusqueda.value = ""
		thisform.RemoveObject(this.Parent.Name)
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_favoritos AS container 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="container" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*-- OBJECTDATA items order determines ZOrder / El orden de los items OBJECTDATA determina el ZOrder 
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="oLblMenu" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="oBtnFavoritos" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />

	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*m: cargarfavoritos
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		BackColor = 255,255,255
		BackStyle = 0
		BorderWidth = 0
		Height = 406
		Name = "tg_favoritos"
		Width = 650
	*</PropValue>

	ADD OBJECT 'oBtnFavoritos' AS tg_commandbutton WITH ;
		Caption = "", ;
		Height = 20, ;
		Left = 89, ;
		Name = "oBtnFavoritos", ;
		Picture = ..\bmp\menu_favoritos.png, ;
		SpecialEffect = 0, ;
		Top = 4, ;
		Width = 20
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="commandbutton" />

	ADD OBJECT 'oLblMenu' AS tg_lblmenu WITH ;
		Height = 26, ;
		Left = 7, ;
		Name = "oLblMenu", ;
		Top = 5, ;
		Width = 64
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_menu.vcx" BaseClass="label" />
	
	PROCEDURE cargarfavoritos
		LOCAL nCantFavoritos, lbCond, nCantBotonesDelMenu, nMaximoLenCaption, nCantIdealAncho, nCantIdealLargo, lIdealEncontrado, nAnchos, nCantIdealLargoEx, nAltoExacto
		
		lbCond = oApp.NombreExe="EIFFEL" .OR. oApp.NombreExe="TARGETDESARROLLO"
		this.oTblFavoritos.Filtrar([id_usuario = "]+ oApp.CodUsuario() + [" and ] + IIF(lbCond,"","!")+"Eiffel")
		this.oTblFavoritos.FijarTag("CLAVE")
		
		nTopInicial= 30
		nTop = nTopInicial
		nLeftInicial = 2
		nLeft = nLeftInicial
		nAncho = 200
		nAlto = 150
		nCantidadBtn = 1
		nAnchos = 0
		
		nMaximoLenCaption = 0
		nCantBotonesDelMenu = 0
		this.oTblFavoritos.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oTblFavoritos.EsEof()
			nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
			
			IF nMaximoLenCaption < LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oTblFavoritos.Leer("opcion")))
				nMaximoLenCaption = LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oTblFavoritos.Leer("opcion")))
			ENDIF 
			
			this.oTblFavoritos.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		nCantIdealAncho = 1
		nCantIdealLargo = 1
		nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargo 
		lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		DO WHILE !lIdealEncontrado
			IF nCantBotonesDelMenu / nCantIdealAncho <= nCantIdealLargo
				lIdealEncontrado = .T.
			ELSE
				nCantIdealAncho = nCantIdealAncho + 1
				nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargoEx + 3/4
				nCantIdealLargo = ROUND(nCantIdealLargoEx,0)
			ENDIF 
		ENDDO 
		
		nAncho = 100 
		nAltoExacto = 50
		nAlto = nAltoExacto
		nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 2 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
		nLeft = nLeftInicial
		
		nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - (nAlto + 2 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho + IIF(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) < 0.5 AND nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) <> 0,1,0),0)) / 2,0)
		nTop = nTopInicial 
		DO WHILE nLeftInicial < 2 OR nTopInicial < 2
			nAncho = nAncho - 1
			nAltoExacto = nAltoExacto - 3/4
			nAlto = ROUND(nAltoExacto,0)
		
			nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 2 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
			nLeft = nLeftInicial
			
		**	nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - (nAlto + 2 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho,0)) / 2,0)
			nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - (nAlto + 2 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho + IIF(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) < 0.5 AND nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) <> 0,1,0),0)) / 2,0)
			nTop = nTopInicial 
		ENDDO 
			
			
		nCantFavoritos = 0
		this.oTblFavoritos.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oTblFavoritos.EsEof()
		
			nCantFavoritos = nCantFavoritos + 1
			this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantFavoritos)),"tg_abrirForm", this.oTblFavoritos.Leer("id_proceso"), this.oTblFavoritos.Leer("id_tipoproceso"))
			
			lbObject = "this.oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantFavoritos))
			WITH &lbObject.
			
		*!*			lbIco = this.oTblFavoritos.Leer("imagen")
		*!*			IF !EMPTY(lbIco)
		*!*				.picture = "c:\targetdesarrollo\bmp\"+ALLTRIM(lbico)
		*!*			ENDIF
				
				.Caption = ALLTRIM(this.oTblFavoritos.Leer("opcion"))
				.Width = nAncho
				.Height = nAlto
				.Visible = .T.
				
				.Top = nTop
				.Left= nLeft
				
				nAnchos = nAnchos + 1
				IF nAnchos < nCantIdealAncho
					nLeft = nLeft + .Width + 2
				ELSE
					nLeft = nLeftInicial
					nAnchos = 0
					nTop = nTop + .height + 2
				ENDIF 
			ENDWITH
					
			this.oTblFavoritos.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		this.oBtnFavoritos.Top = this.oLblMenu.Top + 2
		this.oBtnFavoritos.Left = this.oLblMenu.Left + this.oLblMenu.Width + 24
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		this.addobject("oTblFavoritos", "tg_tabla", "menufavoritos", "CLAVE")
		
		this.oLblMenu.Caption = "Favoritos"
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE cargarvalores
		LPARAMETERS cNombre, cValor
		
		this.oLblNombre.Caption = ALLTRIM(cNombre)
		IF TYPE("cValor") <> "C"
			this.oLblValor.Caption = ALLTRIM(STR(cValor))
		ELSE
			this.oLblValor.Caption = ALLTRIM(cValor)
		ENDIF 
		
		IF VAL(this.oLblValor.Caption) > 0
			this.oLblValor.ForeColor = RGB(0,138,0)
		ELSE
			this.oLblValor.ForeColor = RGB(162,0,37)
		ENDIF
		
		this.oLblNombre.Left = (this.Width - this.oLblNombre.Width) / 2
		this.oLblValor.Left = this.oLblNombre.Left
		this.oLblNombre.Top = (this.Height - this.oLblNombre.Height - this.oLblValor.Height) / 3
		this.oLblValor.Top = this.oLblNombre.Top * 2 + this.oLblNombre.Height 
		this.oBtnRefrescar.top = 2
		this.oBtnRefrescar.Left = this.Width - this.oBtnRefrescar.Width - 2
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_indicadores AS container 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="container" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*-- OBJECTDATA items order determines ZOrder / El orden de los items OBJECTDATA determina el ZOrder 
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="oLblMenu" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="oBtnIndicadores" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />

	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*m: calcularvalorindicador
		*m: cargarindicadores
		*p: consumirws
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		BackColor = 255,255,255
		BackStyle = 0
		BorderWidth = 0
		consumirws = .F.
		Height = 406
		Name = "tg_indicadores"
		Width = 650
	*</PropValue>

	ADD OBJECT 'oBtnIndicadores' AS tg_commandbutton WITH ;
		Caption = "", ;
		Height = 20, ;
		Left = 97, ;
		Name = "oBtnIndicadores", ;
		Picture = ..\bmp\menu_indicadores.png, ;
		Top = 7, ;
		Width = 20
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="commandbutton" />

	ADD OBJECT 'oLblMenu' AS tg_lblmenu WITH ;
		Left = 6, ;
		Name = "oLblMenu", ;
		Top = 6
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_menu.vcx" BaseClass="label" />
	
	PROCEDURE calcularvalorindicador
		LOCAL loSoapClient, loSoapClientUrl, cMetodo
		LOCAL cDiaDesde, cDiaHasta, cMesDesde, cMesHasta, cAnioDesde, cAnioHasta, oResultado
		
		&&RETURN 0
		
		this.consumirWS = .T.
		
		loSoapClient = CREATEOBJECT("MSSOAP.SoapClient30") 
		loSoapClientUrl = ALLTRIM(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("ws")) 
		loSoapClient.MSSoapInit(&loSoapClientUrl)
		
		DO CASE 
			CASE this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("tipoparams") = 1 && ESPERA MONEDA, FECHA DESDE, FECHA HASTA
				cDiaDesde = ALLTRIM(STR(DAY(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("fecha_desde"))))
				IF LEN(cDiaDesde) < 2
					cDiaDesde = "0" + ALLTRIM(STR(DAY(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("fecha_desde"))))	
				ENDIF 
		
				cDiaHasta= ALLTRIM(STR(DAY(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("fecha_hasta"))))
				IF LEN(cDiaHasta) < 2
					cDiaHasta= "0" + ALLTRIM(STR(DAY(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("fecha_hasta"))))	
				ENDIF 
		
				cMesDesde = ALLTRIM(STR(MONTH(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("fecha_desde"))))
				IF LEN(cMesDesde) < 2
					cMesDesde = "0" + ALLTRIM(STR(MONTH(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("fecha_desde"))))	
				ENDIF
		
				cMesHasta = ALLTRIM(STR(MONTH(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("fecha_hasta"))))
				IF LEN(cMesHasta) < 2
					cMesHasta = "0" + ALLTRIM(STR(MONTH(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("fecha_hasta"))))	
				ENDIF
		
				cAnioDesde = ALLTRIM(STR(YEAR(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("fecha_desde"))))
				cAnioHasta = ALLTRIM(STR(YEAR(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("fecha_hasta"))))
		
				cMetodo = "loSoapClient." + ALLTRIM(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("wm")) + "(";
					+ "'" + ALLTRIM(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("id_moneda")) + "'," +; 
					+ "'" + cDiaDesde + "/" + cMesDesde + "/" + cAnioDesde + "',";
					+ "'" + cDiaHasta + "/" + cMesHasta + "/" + cAnioHasta + "')"
		
			CASE this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("tipoparams") = 2 && ESPERA MONEDA
				cMetodo = "loSoapClient." + ALLTRIM(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("wm")) + "(";
				+ "'" + ALLTRIM(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("id_moneda")) + "')"
				
			CASE this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("tipoparams") = 3 && PRUEBA AEREO
				SET STEP ON
				cMetodo = "loSoapClient." + ALLTRIM(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("wm")) + "()"
			
		ENDCASE  
		
		IF (this.consumirWS)
			oResultado = &cMetodo
			IF TYPE("oResultado") <> "N"
				oResultado = VAL(oResultado)
			ENDIF 
			
			RETURN oResultado
		ELSE
			RETURN 0
		ENDIF 
		
		*!*	LOCAL loSoapClient, loSoapClientUrl, cMetodo
		
		*!*	this.consumirWS = .T.
		
		*!*	loSoapClient = CREATEOBJECT("MSSOAP.SoapClient30") 
		*!*	loSoapClientUrl = ALLTRIM(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("ws")) 
		*!*	loSoapClient.MSSoapInit(&loSoapClientUrl)
		
		*!*	cMetodo = "loSoapClient." + ALLTRIM(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.leer("wm")) + "(";
		*!*		+ "'PES',";
		*!*		+ "' ',";
		*!*		+ "' ')"
		*!*		
		*!*	IF (this.consumirWS)
		*!*		RETURN &cMetodo 
		*!*	ELSE
		*!*		RETURN 0
		*!*	ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarindicadores
		LPARAMETERS lHorizontal
		LOCAL nCantIndicadores, lbCond, nCantBotonesDelMenu, nMaximoLenCaption, nCantIdealAncho, nCantIdealLargo, lIdealEncontrado, nAnchos, nCantIdealLargoEx 
		LOCAL vGrabacion
		DIMENSION vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.refrescar(oApp.CodUsuario())
		this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.irPrimero()
		DO WHILE !this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.esEof()
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "valor", this.calcularValorIndicador())
			this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
		
			this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		nTopInicial= 30&&this.oLblMenu.Top + this.oLblMenu.Height + 5
		nTop = nTopInicial
		nLeftInicial = 2
		nLeft = nLeftInicial
		nCantidadBtn = 1
		nAnchos = 0
		
		nMaximoLenCaption = 0
		nCantBotonesDelMenu = 0
		this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.EsEof()
			nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
			
			IF nMaximoLenCaption < LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oTblFavoritos.Leer("nombre")))
				nMaximoLenCaption = LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oTblFavoritos.Leer("nombre")))
			ENDIF 
			
			this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		nCantIdealAncho = 1
		nCantIdealLargo = 1
		nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargo 
		lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		DO WHILE !lIdealEncontrado
			IF nCantBotonesDelMenu / nCantIdealAncho <= nCantIdealLargo
				lIdealEncontrado = .T.
			ELSE
				IF lHorizontal
					nCantIdealAncho = nCantIdealAncho + 1
				ELSE
					nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargoEx + 3/4
					nCantIdealLargo = ROUND(nCantIdealLargoEx,0)
				ENDIF 
			ENDIF 
		ENDDO 
		
		IF lHorizontal
			nAltoExacto = 50
		ELSE
			nAltoExacto = 75
		ENDIF 
		
		nAncho = 150 
		nAlto = nAltoExacto
		IF lHorizontal
			nLeftInicial = 5
			nTopInicial = this.oLblMenu.Top + this.oLblMenu.Height + 5
		ELSE
			nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 2 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
			nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - (nAlto + 2 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho,0)) / 2,0)
		ENDIF 
		nLeft = nLeftInicial
		
		nTop = nTopInicial 
		DO WHILE nLeftInicial < 2 OR nTopInicial < 2
			nAncho = nAncho - 1
			nAltoExacto = nAltoExacto - 3/4
			nAlto = ROUND(nAltoExacto,0)
		
			IF lHorizontal
				nLeftInicial = 5
				nTopInicial = this.oLblMenu.Top + this.oLblMenu.Height + 5
			ELSE
				nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 2 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
				nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - (nAlto + 2 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho,0)) / 2,0)
			ENDIF 
			nLeft = nLeftInicial
			nTop = nTopInicial 
		ENDDO 
			
			
		nCantIndicadores = 0
		this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.EsEof()
		
			nCantIndicadores = nCantIndicadores + 1
			this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantIndicadores)),"tg_indicador")
			
			lbObject = "this.oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantIndicadores))
			WITH &lbObject.		
				.Width = nAncho
				.Height = nAlto
				.Visible = .T.
				
				.Top = nTop
				.Left= nLeft
				
				nAnchos = nAnchos + 1
				IF nAnchos < nCantIdealAncho
					nLeft = nLeft + .Width + 2
				ELSE
					nLeft = nLeftInicial
					nAnchos = 0
					nTop = nTop + .height + 2
				ENDIF 
				
				.CargarValores(this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.Leer("nombre"), this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.Leer("valor"))
			ENDWITH
					
			this.oViewIndicadoresUsuario.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		this.oBtnIndicadores.Top = this.oLblMenu.Top + 3
		this.oBtnIndicadores.Left = this.oLblMenu.Left + this.oLblMenu.Width + 50
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Error
		LPARAMETERS nError, cMethod, nLine
		
		this.consumirWS = .F.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		this.AddObject("oViewIndicadoresUsuario", "tg_viewIndicadoresUsuario")
		
		this.oLblMenu.Caption = "Indicadores"
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="label" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

		ForeColor = 255,255,255
		Height = 26

	*</PropValue>

 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="container" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*-- OBJECTDATA items order determines ZOrder / El orden de los items OBJECTDATA determina el ZOrder

	PROCEDURE cargarbotones
		lParameters cModulo, cNombreMenu, cEtiqueta
		
		this.modulo = cModulo
		this.nombreMenu = cNombreMenu
		this.etiqueta = cEtiqueta
		
		IF TYPE("cModulo") = "C" AND cModulo = "PRINCIPAL"
			this.cargarModulos(cModulo, cNombreMenu)
			this.oLblMenu.caption = ""
		ELSE 
			this.cargarOpcionesModulo(cModulo, cNombreMenu, cEtiqueta)
			this.oLblMenu.caption = cEtiqueta
			**this.oCmbVolver.ToolTipText = cEtiqueta
		ENDIF 
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarmodulos
		lParameters cModulo, cNombreMenu
		LOCAL lbObject, nAncho, nAlto, nLeft, nTop, nCantModulos, nDistanciaEntreBotones
		
		nCantModulos = 0
		this.oVwModulos.Refrescar()
		this.oVwModulos.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oVwModulos.EsEof()
			nCantModulos = nCantModulos + 1
			this.oVwModulos.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO 
		
		nAncho = 150
		nAlto = 40
		
		nLeft = 2
		nTop = 2 
		
		this.oVwModulos.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oVwModulos.EsEof()
			thisform.nIdBoton = thisform.nIdBoton + 1
		
			lbObject = "oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton))
			DIMENSION thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3]
			thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 1] = SUBSTR(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Nombre")),5,6)
			thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 2] = this.oVwModulos.Leer("menuLlamar")
			thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3] = ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta"))
						
			IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta"))) <> "FAVORITOS"
				this.AddObject(lbObject,"tg_opcionMenu")
				
				lbObject = "this."+lbObject
				WITH &lbObject.
					.Caption = " > " + ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta"))
					.Width = nAncho
					.Height = nAlto
					.Visible = .T.
					.Alignment = 0
					.FontSize = 10
					
					IF !this.oVwModulos.Leer("visible")
						.Enabled = .F.
						.BackColor = RGB(128,128,128)
					ENDIF 
					
					.Top = nTop
					.Left= nLeft
				
					nTop = nTop + nAlto 
				ENDWITH
			ENDIF 
			this.oVwModulos.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		*!*	LOCAL nTop, nAltoTotal, nTopInicial, nLeft, nAncho, nAlto, nCantidadBtn, nAnchoChico, nAltoChico, nLeftInicial 
		*!*	LOCAL nCantBotonesDelMenu, nMaximoLenCaption, nCantIdealAncho, nCantIdealLargo, lIdealEncontrado, nAnchos, nCantIdealLargoEx, nAltoExacto, nTopBase
		
		*!*	nAltoTotal = this.Height
		*!*	nTopInicial= 30
		*!*	nTopBase = 0
		*!*	nTop = nTopInicial
		*!*	nLeftInicial = 2
		*!*	nLeft = nLeftInicial
		*!*	nAncho = 200
		*!*	nAnchoChico = 100
		*!*	nAlto = 75
		*!*	nAltoChico = 50
		*!*	nCantidadBtn = 1
		
		*!*	nCantBotonesDelMenu = 0
		*!*	nMaximoLenCaption = 0
		*!*	nCantIdealAncho = 0
		*!*	nCantIdealLargo = 0
		*!*	nCantIdealLargoEx = 0
		*!*	lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		*!*	nAnchos = 0
		
		
		*!*	this.oVwModulos.Refrescar()
		*!*	this.oVwModulos.irPrimero()
		*!*	*!*	do while !this.oVwModulos.EsEof()
		*!*	*!*		nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
		*!*	*!*		
		*!*	*!*		IF nMaximoLenCaption < LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta")))
		*!*	*!*			nMaximoLenCaption = LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta")))
		*!*	*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*		
		*!*	*!*		this.oVwModulos.irSiguiente()
		*!*	*!*	ENDDO
		
		*!*	*!*	nCantIdealAncho = 1
		*!*	*!*	nCantIdealLargo = nCantBotonesDelMenu 
		
		*!*	*!*	*!*	nCantIdealAncho = 1
		*!*	*!*	*!*	nCantIdealLargo = 1
		*!*	*!*	*!*	nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargo 
		*!*	*!*	*!*	lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		*!*	*!*	*!*	DO WHILE !lIdealEncontrado
		*!*	*!*	*!*		IF nCantBotonesDelMenu / nCantIdealAncho <= nCantIdealLargo
		*!*	*!*	*!*			lIdealEncontrado = .T.
		*!*	*!*	*!*		ELSE
		*!*	*!*	*!*			nCantIdealAncho = nCantIdealAncho + 1
		*!*	*!*	*!*			nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargoEx + 3/4
		*!*	*!*	*!*			nCantIdealLargo = ROUND(nCantIdealLargoEx,0)
		*!*	*!*	*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*	*!*	ENDDO 
		
		*!*	*!*	nAncho = 40 
		*!*	*!*	nAltoExacto = 40
		*!*	*!*	nAlto = nAltoExacto
		
		*!*	*!*	nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - nAncho) / 2,0)
		*!*	*!*	nLeft = nLeftInicial
		
		*!*	*!*	nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho + IIF(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) < 0.5 AND nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) <> 0,1,0),0)) / 2,0)
		*!*	*!*	nTop = nTopInicial 
		
		*!*	*!*	DO WHILE nLeftInicial < 2 OR nTopInicial < 2
		*!*	*!*		**nAncho = nAncho - 1
		*!*	*!*		nAltoExacto = nAltoExacto - 3/4
		*!*	*!*		nAlto = ROUND(nAltoExacto,0)
		
		*!*	*!*		**nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 4 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
		*!*	*!*		**nLeft = nLeftInicial
		*!*	*!*		
		*!*	*!*		nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho + IIF(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) < 0.5 AND nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) <> 0,1,0),0)) / 2,0)
		*!*	*!*		nTop = nTopInicial 
		*!*	*!*	ENDDO 
		
		
		*!*	do while !this.oVwModulos.EsEof()
		*!*		nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
		*!*		
		*!*		IF nMaximoLenCaption < LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta")))
		*!*			nMaximoLenCaption = LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta")))
		*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*		this.oVwModulos.irSiguiente()
		*!*	ENDDO
		
		*!*	nCantIdealAncho = 1
		*!*	nCantIdealLargo = 1
		*!*	nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargo 
		*!*	lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		*!*	DO WHILE !lIdealEncontrado
		*!*		IF nCantBotonesDelMenu / nCantIdealAncho <= nCantIdealLargo
		*!*			lIdealEncontrado = .T.
		*!*		ELSE
		*!*			nCantIdealAncho = nCantIdealAncho + 1
		*!*			**nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargoEx + this.Width / (this.Height - nTopBase)
		*!*			**nCantIdealLargo = ROUND(nCantIdealLargoEx,0)
		*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*	ENDDO 		
		
		*!*	nAncho = 100
		*!*	nAltoExacto = 75 
		*!*	nAlto = nAltoExacto
		*!*	nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 4 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
		*!*	nLeft = nLeftInicial
		
		*!*	nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - nTopBase - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho,0)) / 2,0)
		*!*	nTop = nTopInicial 
		*!*	DO WHILE nLeftInicial < 2 OR nTopInicial < (2 + nTopBase)
		*!*		nAncho = nAncho - 1
		*!*		nAltoExacto = nAltoExacto - this.Width / (this.Height - nTopBase)
		*!*		nAlto = ROUND(nAltoExacto,0)
		
		*!*		nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 4 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
		*!*		nLeft = nLeftInicial
		*!*		
		*!*		nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - nTopBase - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho,0)) / 2,0)
		*!*		nTop = nTopInicial 
		*!*	ENDDO 
		
		
		*!*	this.oVwModulos.irPrimero()
		*!*	do while !this.oVwModulos.EsEof()
		*!*		thisform.nIdBoton = thisform.nIdBoton + 1
		
		*!*		lbObject = "oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton))
		*!*		DIMENSION thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 2]
		*!*		thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 1] = SUBSTR(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Nombre")),5,6)
		*!*		thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 2] = this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta")
		*!*					
		*!*		IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta"))) <> "FAVORITOS"
		*!*			this.AddObject(lbObject,"tg_opcionMenu")
		*!*			
		*!*			lbObject = "this."+lbObject
		*!*			WITH &lbObject.
		*!*				.Caption = ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta"))
		*!*				.Width = nAncho
		*!*				.Height = nAlto
		*!*				.Visible = .T.
		*!*				
		*!*				.Top = nTop - 28
		*!*				.Left= nLeft	
		*!*				
		*!*				nAnchos = nAnchos + 1
		*!*				IF nAnchos < nCantIdealAncho
		*!*					nLeft = nLeft + .Width + 4
		*!*				ELSE
		*!*					nLeft = nLeftInicial
		*!*					nAnchos = 0
		*!*					nTop = nTop + .height + 4
		*!*				ENDIF 
		*!*			ENDWITH
		*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*		this.oVwModulos.irSiguiente()
		*!*	ENDDO
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargaropcionesmodulo
		lParameters cModulo, cNombreMenu, cEtiqueta
		LOCAL nTop, nAltoTotal, nTopInicial, nLeft, nAncho, nAlto, nCantidadBtn, nAnchoChico, nAltoChico, nLeftInicial 
		LOCAL nCantBotonesDelMenu, nMaximoLenCaption, nCantIdealAncho, nCantIdealLargo, lIdealEncontrado, nAnchos, nCantIdealLargoEx, nAltoExacto, nTopBase, nCantIdealAnchoEx 
		nAltoTotal = this.Height
		
		nTopBase = this.oCmbVolver.Top + this.oCmbVolver.Height + 2
		
		nTop = nTopInicial
		nLeftInicial = 2
		nLeft = nLeftInicial
		nAncho = 200
		nAnchoChico = 100
		nAlto = 75
		nAltoChico = 50
		nCantidadBtn = 1
		
		nCantBotonesDelMenu = 0
		nMaximoLenCaption = 0
		nCantIdealAncho = 0
		nCantIdealLargo = 0
		nCantIdealLargoEx = 0
		lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		nAnchos = 0
		
		this.oVwOpciones.Refrescar(cModulo)
		this.oVwOpciones.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oVwOpciones.EsEof()
			IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("menu"))) = UPPER(ALLTRIM(cNombreMenu)) 
				nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
				
				IF nMaximoLenCaption < LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("Etiqueta")))
					nMaximoLenCaption = LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("Etiqueta")))
				ENDIF 
			ENDIF 
			this.oVwOpciones.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		nCantIdealAncho = 1
		nCantIdealLargo = 1
		nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargo 
		nCantIdealAnchoEx = nCantIdealAncho
		lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		DO WHILE !lIdealEncontrado
			IF nCantBotonesDelMenu / nCantIdealLargo <= nCantIdealAncho &&nCantBotonesDelMenu / nCantIdealAncho <= nCantIdealLargo
				lIdealEncontrado = .T.
			ELSE
				nCantIdealAnchoEx = nCantIdealAncho + this.Width / (this.Height - nTopBase) &&+ 1 
				nCantIdealAncho = INT(nCantIdealAnchoEx) &&+ 1 
				nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargoEx + 1 &&+ this.Width / (this.Height - nTopBase)
				nCantIdealLargo = INT(nCantIdealLargoEx) &&ROUND(nCantIdealLargoEx,0)
			ENDIF 
		ENDDO 		
		
		nAncho = 100
		nAltoExacto = 75 
		nAlto = nAltoExacto
		nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 4 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
		nLeft = nLeftInicial
		
		nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - nTopBase - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho,0)) / 2,0)
		nTop = nTopInicial 
		DO WHILE nLeftInicial < 2 OR nTopInicial < (2 + nTopBase)
			nAncho = nAncho - 1
			nAltoExacto = nAltoExacto - this.Width / (this.Height - nTopBase)
			nAlto = ROUND(nAltoExacto,0)
		
			nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 4 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
			nLeft = nLeftInicial
			
			nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - nTopBase - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho,0)) / 2,0)
			nTop = nTopInicial 
		ENDDO 
		
		this.idDesde = thisform.nIdBoton + 1
		 		
		this.oVwOpciones.Refrescar(cModulo)
		this.oVwOpciones.irPrimero()
		DO WHILE !this.oVwOpciones.EsEof()
		 		IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("menu"))) = UPPER(ALLTRIM(cNombreMenu)) 
		 	
		 		thisform.nIdBoton = thisform.nIdBoton + 1
				IF (this.oVwOpciones.Leer("id_tipoproceso") = "SUB") 
					this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton)),"tg_opcionMenu")
				ELSE
					this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton)),"tg_abrirForm", this.oVwOpciones.Leer("id_proceso"), this.oVwOpciones.Leer("id_tipoproceso"))
				ENDIF 
				
				DIMENSION thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3]
				thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 1] = cModulo
				thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 2] = this.oVwOpciones.Leer("menuLlamar")
				thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3] = cEtiqueta + "/" + ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("etiqueta"))
		
				lbObject = "this.oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton))
				WITH &lbObject.
				
		*!*					lbIco = this.oVwOpciones.Leer("imagen")
		*!*					IF !EMPTY(lbIco)
		*!*						.picture = "c:\targetdesarrollo\bmp\"+ALLTRIM(lbico)
		*!*					ENDIF
		*!*					
					.Caption = ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("Etiqueta"))
					.Width = nAncho
					.Height = nAlto
					.Visible = .T.
					
					.Top = nTop
					.Left= nLeft
					
					nAnchos = nAnchos + 1
					IF nAnchos < nCantIdealAncho
						nLeft = nLeft + .Width + 4
					ELSE
						nLeft = nLeftInicial
						nAnchos = 0
						nTop = nTop + .height + 4
					ENDIF 
				ENDWITH
			ENDIF 
			this.oVwOpciones.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		this.idHasta = thisform.nIdBoton
		
		this.oLblMenu.Top = this.oCmbVolver.Top 
		this.oLblMenu.Left = this.oCmbVolver.Left + this.oCmbVolver.Width + 20
		
		**this.oLblMenu.Top = nTopInicial - this.oLblMenu.Height - 5
		**this.oLblMenu.Left = nLeftInicial
	ENDPROC

	HIDDEN PROCEDURE gjm_redimensionaobjetos		&& Metodo Principal para redirmensionar lso objetos y moverse
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		this.addobject("oVwModulos"			,"tg_viewMenuTreeviewModulos")
		this.addobject("oVwOpciones"		,"tg_viewMenuTreeview")
		
		FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
			**IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].parentClass) = UPPER("Container")
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_modulos") AND UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Name) <> UPPER("oContModulos")
				thisform.Objects[i].visible = .F.
			ENDIF  
		ENDFOR 
		
		this.Visible = .T.
		**this.cargarBotones(cModulo)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE limpiar
		LOCAL i
		FOR i = this.idDesde TO this.idHasta
			this.RemoveObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(i)))
		ENDFOR 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmbVolver.Click
		thisform.cantContenedores = thisform.cantContenedores - 1
		
		FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].name) = UPPER("oContOpciones" + ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.cantContenedores)))
				thisform.Objects[i].visible = .T.
			ENDIF
		ENDFOR
		
		thisform.RemoveObject(this.Parent.Name)
		
		*!*	this.Visible = .F.
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_opcionmenu AS commandbutton 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="commandbutton" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*p: ocontopcionesmodulo
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		BackColor = 27,161,226
		Caption = "Prueba"
		ForeColor = 255,255,255
		Height = 105
		MousePointer = 15
		Name = "tg_opcionmenu"
		ocontopcionesmodulo = .F.
		PicturePosition = 13
		SpecialEffect = 1
		Style = 0
		Width = 207
	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE Click
		LOCAL cNuevoContenedor
		
		thisform.cantContenedores = thisform.cantContenedores + 1
		cNuevoContenedor = "oContOpciones" + ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.cantContenedores))
		thisform.AddObject(cNuevoContenedor, "tg_modulos")
		cNuevoContenedor = "thisform." + cNuevoContenedor
		WITH &cNuevoContenedor.
		*!*		.top = this.Parent.Top
		*!*		.left = this.Parent.left
		*!*		.width = this.Parent.Width
		*!*		.height = this.Parent.Height
			.top = thisform.oContOpciones1.top
			.left = thisform.oContOpciones1.left 
			.width = thisform.oContOpciones1.width 
			.height = thisform.oContOpciones1.height 
			.cargarBotones(thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[VAL(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(this.Name,5,LEN(this.name)))), 1], thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[VAL(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(this.Name,5,LEN(this.name)))), 2], thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[VAL(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(this.Name,5,LEN(this.name)))), 3])
		ENDWITH
		
		thisform.oTbxBusqueda.setFocus()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		this.WordWrap = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE MouseEnter
		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord
		
		this.BackColor = RGB(0,80,239)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE MouseLeave
		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord
		
		this.BackColor = RGB(27,161,226)
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

		Height = 228, ;
		Left = 617, ;
		Name = "oContRecientes", ;

		oLblMenu.Name = "oLblMenu"

	ADD OBJECT 'oTbxBusqueda' AS tg_textbox WITH ;
		Height = 21, ;
		Left = 20, ;
		Name = "oTbxBusqueda", ;
		Top = 104, ;
		Width = 180, ;
		ZOrderSet = 12
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />
	
	PROCEDURE Init
		DODEFAULT()
		thisform.AddObject("oTblUsuarios", "tg_tabla", "usuarios", "CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblProcesos","tg_tabla","procesos", "CLAVE")
		
		**thisform.WindowType = 1
		thisform.cantContenedores = 1
		thisform.nIdBoton = 1
		thisform.nIdBotonBusqueda = 1
		thisform.tipoFormulario = 1
		
		IF SYSMETRIC(1) > 1024
			thisform.anchoInicialItems = 600
		ELSE
			thisform.anchoInicialItems = 500
		ENDIF 
		
		thisform.Picture = "FondoMenu.jpg"
		
		thisform.oContModulos.Width = 160
		thisform.oContModulos.left = 2
		thisform.oContModulos.cargarBotones("PRINCIPAL", "Menú Principal")
		
		thisform.oContOpciones1.width = thisform.anchoInicialItems  &&550
		thisform.oContOpciones1.height = 500
		thisform.oContOpciones1.top = 80
		thisform.oContOpciones1.left = thisform.oContModulos.Left + thisform.oContModulos.Width + 15 &&50
		thisform.oContOpciones1.visible = .F.
		thisform.oContOpciones1.OLblMenu.Visible = .F.
		
		thisform.oContModulos.top = thisform.oContOpciones1.Top - thisform.oTbxBusqueda.Height - 7 + 75 &&80  &&130 &&thisform.oContOpciones1.Top - thisform.oTbxBusqueda.Height - 5
		thisform.oContModulos.height = thisform.Height - thisform.oContModulos.Top - 10
		
		thisform.oContFavoritos.Width = 300 
		thisform.oContFavoritos.height = thisform.oContOpciones1.Height / 2 
		thisform.oContFavoritos.top = thisform.oContOpciones1.top + thisform.oContOpciones1.Height / 2 
		thisform.oContFavoritos.left = thisform.oContOpciones1.Width + thisform.oContOpciones1.Left + 15
		thisform.oContFavoritos.cargarFavoritos()
		
		thisform.oContRecientes.Width = thisform.oContFavoritos.Width
		thisform.oContRecientes.height = thisform.oContOpciones1.Height / 2 
		thisform.oContRecientes.top = thisform.oContOpciones1.top
		thisform.oContRecientes.left = thisform.oContFavoritos.left
		thisform.oContRecientes.cargarRecientes()
		
		IF SYSMETRIC(1) > 1024
			thisform.oContIndicadores.Width = 160
			thisform.oContIndicadores.Height = this.oContOpciones1.Height 
			
			IF SYSMETRIC(1) > 1280
				thisform.oContIndicadores.Left = this.oContRecientes.Left + this.oContRecientes.Width + 50
			ELSE
				thisform.oContIndicadores.Left = this.oContRecientes.Left + this.oContRecientes.Width + 25	
			ENDIF 
			
			thisform.oContIndicadores.Top = this.oContOpciones1.Top
			thisform.oContIndicadores.cargarIndicadores(.F.)
		ELSE
			thisform.oContIndicadores.Height = 100
			thisform.oContIndicadores.Left = thisform.oContOpciones1.Left 
			thisform.oContIndicadores.Top = thisform.oContOpciones1.Top + thisform.ocontOpciones1.Height + 5 - 50
			thisform.oContIndicadores.Width = thisform.Width - thisform.oContIndicadores.left - 20
			thisform.oContIndicadores.cargarIndicadores(.T.)
		ENDIF 
		
		thisform.oTbxBusqueda.Left = thisform.oContModulos.Left + 2 &&thisform.oContOpciones1.Left + 5
		thisform.oTbxBusqueda.Top = thisform.oContModulos.Top - thisform.oBtnFavoritos.Height - 5 &&thisform.oContOpciones1.Top - thisform.oTbxBusqueda.Height - 5
		thisform.oTbxBusqueda.Width = thisform.oContModulos.Width - 10
		
		thisform.oBtnFavoritos.Left = thisform.oTbxBusqueda.left && thisform.oTbxBusqueda.left + thisform.oTbxBusqueda.Width + 15
		thisform.oBtnRecientes.Left = thisform.oBtnFavoritos.Left + thisform.oBtnFavoritos.Width + 10
		thisform.oBtnIndicadores.Left = thisform.oBtnRecientes.Left + thisform.oBtnRecientes.Width + 10
		
		thisform.oBtnFavoritos.Top = thisform.oBtnFavoritos.Top - thisform.oBtnFavoritos.Height - thisform.oTbxBusqueda.Height - 5 &&thisform.oTbxBusqueda.Top 
		thisform.oBtnRecientes.Top = thisform.oBtnFavoritos.Top 
		thisform.oBtnIndicadores.Top = thisform.oBtnFavoritos.Top 
		
		thisform.oBtnFavoritos.visible = .T.
		thisform.oBtnRecientes.visible = .T.
		thisform.oBtnIndicadores.visible = .T.
		
		IF thisform.oTblUsuarios.buscar(oApp.CodUsuario(), .F., "CLAVE")
			IF !thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("recientes")
				thisform.oBtnRecientes.Click()
			ENDIF 
			
			IF !thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("favoritos")
				thisform.oBtnFavoritos.Click()
			ENDIF 
			
			IF !thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("indicador")
				thisform.oBtnIndicadores.Click()
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oBtnFavoritos.Click
		thisform.oContFavoritos.Visible = !thisform.oContFavoritos.visible
		
		IF !thisform.oContFavoritos.visible
			thisform.oContRecientes.Height = thisform.oContOpciones1.Height
			thisform.oContRecientes.Top = thisform.oContOpciones1.Top
		ELSE
			thisform.oContRecientes.Height = thisform.oContOpciones1.Height / 2 
			thisform.oContRecientes.Top = thisform.oContOpciones1.Top
		ENDIF 
		
		FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
			IF SUBSTR(UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].name),1,13) = UPPER("oContOpciones")
				thisform.Objects[i].Width = thisform.anchoInicialItems
				nItem = ROUND(VAL(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(thisform.Objects[i].name,14,LEN(thisform.Objects[i].name)))),0)
				IF TYPE("thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[nItem, 1]") <> "L"
					thisform.Objects[i].limpiar()
					thisform.Objects[i].cargarBotones(thisform.Objects[i].modulo, thisform.Objects[i].nombreMenu, thisform.Objects[i].etiqueta)
				ENDIF 
			ENDIF
		ENDFOR
		
		IF !thisform.oContRecientes.Visible AND !thisform.oContFavoritos.Visible 
			FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
				IF SUBSTR(UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].name),1,13) = UPPER("oContOpciones")
					thisform.Objects[i].Width = thisform.anchoInicialItems + thisform.oContFavoritos.Width + 20	
					nItem = ROUND(VAL(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(thisform.Objects[i].name,14,LEN(thisform.Objects[i].name)))),0)
					IF TYPE("thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[nItem, 1]") <> "L"
						thisform.Objects[i].limpiar()
						thisform.Objects[i].cargarBotones(thisform.Objects[i].modulo, thisform.Objects[i].nombreMenu, thisform.Objects[i].etiqueta)
					ENDIF 
				ENDIF
			ENDFOR
		ENDIF 
		
		
		IF thisform.oTblUsuarios.buscar(oApp.CodUsuario(), .F., "CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "favoritos", thisform.oContFavoritos.Visible)
			thisform.oTblUsuarios.modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
		ENDIF 
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oBtnIndicadores.Click
		thisform.oContIndicadores.visible = !thisform.oContIndicadores.visible
		
		IF !thisform.oContIndicadores.visible
		
		ELSE
		
		ENDIF 
		
		IF thisform.oTblUsuarios.buscar(oApp.CodUsuario(), .F., "CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "indicador", thisform.oContIndicadores.Visible)
			thisform.oTblUsuarios.modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
		ENDIF
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oBtnRecientes.Click
		LOCAL nItem
		
		thisform.oContRecientes.visible = !thisform.oContRecientes.visible
		
		IF !thisform.oContRecientes.visible
			thisform.oContFavoritos.Top = thisform.oContOpciones1.Top 
			thisform.oContFavoritos.Height = thisform.oContOpciones1.Height
		ELSE
			thisform.oContFavoritos.top = thisform.oContOpciones1.top + thisform.oContOpciones1.Height / 2 
			thisform.oContFavoritos.height = thisform.oContOpciones1.Height / 2 
		ENDIF 
		
		FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
			IF SUBSTR(ALLTRIM(UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].name)),1,13) = UPPER("oContOpciones")
				thisform.Objects[i].Width = thisform.anchoInicialItems
				
				nItem = ROUND(VAL(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(thisform.Objects[i].name,14,LEN(thisform.Objects[i].name)))),0)
				IF TYPE("thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[nItem, 1]") <> "L"
					thisform.Objects[i].limpiar()
					thisform.Objects[i].cargarBotones(thisform.Objects[i].modulo, thisform.Objects[i].nombreMenu, thisform.Objects[i].etiqueta)
				ENDIF 
			ENDIF
		ENDFOR
		
		IF !thisform.oContRecientes.Visible AND !thisform.oContFavoritos.Visible 
			FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
				IF SUBSTR(UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].name),1,13) = UPPER("oContOpciones")
					thisform.Objects[i].Width = thisform.anchoInicialItems + thisform.oContFavoritos.Width + 20	
					nItem = ROUND(VAL(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(thisform.Objects[i].name,14,LEN(thisform.Objects[i].name)))),0)
					IF TYPE("thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[nItem, 1]") <> "L"
						thisform.Objects[i].limpiar()
						thisform.Objects[i].cargarBotones(thisform.Objects[i].modulo, thisform.Objects[i].nombreMenu, thisform.Objects[i].etiqueta)
					ENDIF 
				ENDIF
			ENDFOR
		ENDIF 
		
		IF thisform.oTblUsuarios.buscar(oApp.CodUsuario(), .F., "CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "recientes", thisform.oContRecientes.Visible)
			thisform.oTblUsuarios.modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxBusqueda.InteractiveChange
		LOCAL cNuevoContenedor
		
		IF LEN(ALLTRIM(this.Value)) > 2
			IF TYPE("thisform.oContBusqueda") = "O"
				thisform.RemoveObject("oContBusqueda")
			ENDIF 
		
			thisform.AddObject("oContBusqueda", "tg_busqueda")
			cNuevoContenedor = "thisform.oContBusqueda"
			WITH &cNuevoContenedor.
				.Width = thisform.oContOpciones1.Width + thisform.oContFavoritos.Width + thisform.oContIndicadores.Width + 6
				.Height = thisform.oContOpciones1.Height
				.Left = thisform.oContOpciones1.Left
				.Top = thisform.oContOpciones1.Top
				.cargarBotones(this.value)
			ENDWITH 
		ELSE
			IF TYPE("thisform.oContBusqueda") = "O"
				thisform.RemoveObject("oContBusqueda")
				
				FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
					IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].parentClass) = UPPER("Container")
						thisform.Objects[i].visible = .T.
					ENDIF  
				ENDFOR 
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF
		
		
		*!*	IF LEN(ALLTRIM(this.Value)) > 2
		*!*		thisform.oContBusqueda.cargarBotones(this.Value)
		*!*	ELSE
		*!*		thisform.oContBusqueda.Visible = .F.
		*!*	ENDIF
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE TG_TIMERBASE.Timer
		thisform.oContRecientes.cargarRecientes()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_recientes AS container 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="container" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*-- OBJECTDATA items order determines ZOrder / El orden de los items OBJECTDATA determina el ZOrder 
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="oLblMenu" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />

	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*m: cargarrecientes
		*m: refrescar
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		BackColor = 255,255,255
		BackStyle = 0
		BorderWidth = 0
		Height = 375
		Name = "tg_recientes"
		Width = 650
	*</PropValue>

	ADD OBJECT 'oLblMenu' AS tg_lblmenu WITH ;
		Left = 3, ;
		Name = "oLblMenu", ;
		Top = 3
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_menu.vcx" BaseClass="label" />
	
	PROCEDURE cargarrecientes
		LOCAL nCantRecientes, lbCond, nCantBotonesDelMenu, nMaximoLenCaption, nCantIdealAncho, nCantIdealLargo, lIdealEncontrado, nAnchos, nCantIdealLargoEx, nAltoExacto
		
		nTopInicial= 30
		nTop = nTopInicial
		nLeftInicial = 2
		nLeft = nLeftInicial
		nAncho = 200
		nAlto = 150
		nCantidadBtn = 1
		nAnchos = 0
		
		nMaximoLenCaption = 0
		nCantBotonesDelMenu = 0
		this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.refrescar()
		this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.EsEof()
			nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
			
			IF nMaximoLenCaption < LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.Leer("titulo")))
				nMaximoLenCaption = LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.Leer("titulo")))
			ENDIF 
			
			this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		nCantIdealAncho = 1
		nCantIdealLargo = 1
		nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargo 
		lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		DO WHILE !lIdealEncontrado
			IF nCantBotonesDelMenu / nCantIdealAncho <= nCantIdealLargo
				lIdealEncontrado = .T.
			ELSE
				nCantIdealAncho = nCantIdealAncho + 1
				nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargoEx + 3/4
				nCantIdealLargo = ROUND(nCantIdealLargoEx,0)
			ENDIF 
		ENDDO 
		
		nAncho = 100 
		nAltoExacto = 50
		nAlto = nAltoExacto
		nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 2 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
		nLeft = nLeftInicial
		
		nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - (nAlto + 2 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho + IIF(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) < 0.5 AND nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) <> 0,1,0),0)) / 2,0)
		nTop = nTopInicial 
		DO WHILE nLeftInicial < 2 OR nTopInicial < 2
			nAncho = nAncho - 1
			nAltoExacto = nAltoExacto - 3/4
			nAlto = ROUND(nAltoExacto,0)
		
			nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 2 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
			nLeft = nLeftInicial
			
			nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - (nAlto + 2 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho + IIF(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) < 0.5 AND nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) <> 0,1,0),0)) / 2,0)
			nTop = nTopInicial 
		ENDDO 
		
		nCantRecientes = 0
		this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.EsEof()
		
			nCantRecientes = nCantRecientes + 1
			this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantRecientes)),"tg_abrirForm", this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.leer("objeto"), this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.Leer("id_tipoproceso"))
			
			lbObject = "this.oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantRecientes))
			WITH &lbObject.
			
		*!*			lbIco = this.oTblFavoritos.Leer("imagen")
		*!*			IF !EMPTY(lbIco)
		*!*				.picture = "c:\targetdesarrollo\bmp\"+ALLTRIM(lbico)
		*!*			ENDIF
				
				.Caption = ALLTRIM(this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.Leer("titulo"))
				.Width = nAncho
				.Height = nAlto
				.Visible = .T.
				
				.Top = nTop
				.Left= nLeft
				
				nAnchos = nAnchos + 1
				IF nAnchos < nCantIdealAncho
					nLeft = nLeft + .Width + 2
				ELSE
					nLeft = nLeftInicial
					nAnchos = 0
					nTop = nTop + .height + 2
				ENDIF 
			ENDWITH
					
			this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		this.AddObject("oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario", "tg_viewFormsRecientesDelUsuario")
		
		this.oLblMenu.Caption = "Recientes"
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescar
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE
